from datetime import date
from latefee import LateFeeCalculator as C

T = date(2024, 3, 29)  # Fri
def f(b, d): return C(T).compute_fee_cents(b, d)

def test_zero_balance(): assert f(0, date(2024, 1, 1)) == 0
def test_due_today(): assert f(1000, T) == 0
def test_in_grace(): assert f(1000, date(2024, 3, 25)) == 0
def test_normal(): assert f(200000, date(2024, 3, 1)) == 1000  # 20 wkdays, 10 billable
def test_min_fee(): assert f(1000, date(2024, 3, 1)) == 500
def test_cap(): assert f(10000, date(2020, 1, 1)) == 2500
def test_default_today(): assert C()._today == date.today()
